shared_normal_visit_contract.if_ready_false: Ordinary non-rank hangout; rank unchanged; point delta unknown in strict model; re-observe readiness
shared_normal_visit_contract.if_ready_unknown: No deterministic rank prediction. Observe before commitment, or return branching policy; do not treat unknown as false

branch_execution_contract.reversal: Invalidate derived readiness; require observed rank and reversal state

branch_execution_contract.conflicting_gate: Default unknown; source-envelope inference requires opt-in
